sources.entry: OnlySwitch - ⚙️ All-in-One menu bar app, hide 💻MacBook Pro's notch, dark mode, AirPods, Shortcuts[![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jacklandrin/OnlySwitch) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
OnlySwitch - All-in-One status bar button, hide MacBook Pro's notch, dark mode, AirPods, Shortcuts

summary.one_liner: OnlySwitch is a free, open-source macOS menu-bar app that bundles many everyday system toggles (hide desktop icons, dark mode, keep awake, notch hiding, AirPods, Shortcuts) into one customizable control list.
summary.what_it_does: It provides a menu-bar icon that opens a customizable list of built-in switches, macOS Shortcuts, and user-built Evolution buttons and switches, which can be reordered and given keyboard shortcuts. A compact Only Control panel and Only Widget desktop/Notification Center widgets trigger the same controls. Additional modules cover System Monitor (CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network), Xcode Cleaner, App Uninstaller, Tailscale account and exit-node control, Codex Usage, Dock window previews, Radio, and a Desktop Pet. Only Agent and OpenClaw allow natural-language triggering of switches, and OnlyRemote lets an iPhone or iPad control the Mac over the local network.
use_cases: Toggle dark mode or hide desktop icons from the menu bar
Keep the Mac awake or mute the microphone quickly
Clean Xcode DerivedData and simulator caches
Uninstall an app along with its leftover files
Monitor CPU, memory, and network usage from the menu bar
Control Mac settings from an iPhone or iPad on the local network
Run custom shell or AppleScript actions with hotkeys
how_to_run: Or download the latest OnlySwitch DMG from the repository's releases
Launch OnlySwitch and enable it under System Settings → Menu Bar if the icon is missing
Click the OnlySwitch menu-bar icon to open the control list
notable: Single menu-bar hub combining dozens of built-in switches, Shortcuts, and user-scripted Evolutions
Hide Menu Bar Icons collapsing divider and Hide notch on M1 Pro/Max MacBook Pro
Only Widget desktop and Notification Center widgets plus OnlyRemote iPhone/iPad control
Only Agent turns plain-English requests into AppleScript, with OpenClaw deeplink integration
Xcode Cleaner and App Uninstaller operate on local Mac files, moving items to Trash
caveats: Several features depend on private or undocumented macOS APIs (GPU stats, Hide Menu Bar Icons on macOS 27) that may break after OS updates and are not suitable for the Mac App Store
Some features need specific macOS versions (Aphrodite and Only Agent need macOS 26+, Evolution needs 13+, Hide notch only works on M1 Pro/Max MacBook Pro built-in displays)
Automatic updating is broken in version 2.5.6 and earlier; those versions must be updated manually or reinstalled with Homebrew
